# Education Gate — Quiz + Mastery Assessment — scripts/goal_loop.py (/goal-loop Phase 1, ADR-0026)
Gate R11 (required, never-skippable before merge). Bloom Understand→Analyze, Tier 2. Verdict: PASS (exceeds Tier 2).

## Process
Walkthrough (4 concepts: R5 verifier-integrity, driver/seam split, R10 fail-closed autonomy, R7 untrusted loop-state) delivered interactively and captured in DISC-20260623-042616-walkthrough-goal-loop-phase1-education. During the walkthrough the developer independently demonstrated Analyze-level mastery via unprompted design questions (generative-gap in goal authoring; capture-stack duplication; loop-state vs discussion structure). Quiz Scenario 1 (the load-bearing "spot a gameable verify" outcome) then administered.

## Quiz Scenario 1 (hollow verifier)
C1 deterministic (verify=`python scripts/check_endpoints.py`, verify_owner: gate). The script always exits 0 (born broken); builder never touches it; C1 goes green though endpoints do nothing.

## Developer answer (verbatim summary) — CORRECT on all four
- Q1: Normally the independent skeptical checker (builder≠judge, R5.2/R4) flags vacuous checks — but it only runs for `llm-judge` criteria; C1 is `verify_owner: gate`, so verify_criterion (goal_loop.py:522) returns the exit code with no skeptic attached. Deeper: independence guards against a builder gaming a verdict, not a verifier born broken — independence ≠ correctness.
- Q2: Tamper tripwire (goal_loop.py:447) does NOT fire — it only fires when THIS tick's diff touches the verifier surface; the builder edited an unrelated comment. It catches CHANGING a verifier, not an already-hollow untouched one (would fire had check_endpoints.py been edited).
- Q3: Goal-met re-verify (R5.4, GOAL_MET branch goal_loop.py:788) does NOT catch it — re-runs the same hollow oracle → same false green. Checks freshness, not validity.
- Q4: A HUMAN stops it, twice: (1) AUTHORING — the developer owns oracle honesty; R5 takes verify as ground truth and cannot prove an external script truly measures its criterion (undecidable); (2) MERGE GATE — goal-met halts for /review + the never-skippable education walkthrough + approval; the catch is a gatekeeper who reads check_endpoints.py and asks "does this assert a 429 or just exit 0?"
- Thesis: the loop can prove a verifier PASSED but never that it was MEANINGFUL; every R5 defense protects the integrity of the green (un-gamed, not stale, not self-judged), none can vouch for the honesty of the oracle — undecidable by design, which is exactly the gap the human merge gate fills.

## Assessment
PASS — exceeds Tier 2. Code refs (verify_criterion:522, tamper_tripwire:447, GOAL_MET:788) verified accurate. The developer articulated the undecidability framing (pass ≠ meaningful) that is the conceptual core of the feature, plus the seam-level reason the checker doesn't attach to gate criteria. Scenarios 2–4 not required; mastery demonstrated. Education gate R11 SATISFIED — merge to main is unblocked (still requires explicit developer OK; push separate).
